# streamsec_azure_scanner_hub (Resource)

Makes an Azure subscription's agentless volume scanner a hub: it also scans other subscriptions of the tenant, as its own managed identity, where that identity holds the scanned-subscriptions role (the azure-tenant module's `modules/volume-scanner-hub-access`, or the console's access template, grants it). Destroying it turns the hub off: each subscription goes back to its own scanner.

A subscription a hub scanned while its coverage was `selected` stays pinned to that hub after it switches to `all`, and another hub can't select it (Stream Security answers 409). To release it, set that hub to `selected` without the subscription, apply, then set it back to `all`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The security subscription's volume scanner also scans the dev and prod subscriptions
# of the tenant.
resource "streamsec_azure_scanner_hub" "security" {
  account_id       = streamsec_azure_tenant.this.id
  subscription_id  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  coverage         = "selected"
  subscription_ids = ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"]
}

# The shared-services subscription's scanner scans every other subscription of the
# tenant that has no scanner of its own and no other hub. Only one hub per tenant may
# cover "all".
resource "streamsec_azure_scanner_hub" "shared_services" {
  account_id      = streamsec_azure_tenant.this.id
  subscription_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004"
  coverage        = "all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The Stream Security id of the Azure tenant (`streamsec_azure_tenant.<name>.id`), not the Azure tenant id. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `coverage` (String) Which subscriptions the hub scans: `all` (every other subscription of the tenant without a scanner of its own and not scanned by another hub) or `selected` (the subscriptions in `subscription_ids`). Only one hub per tenant may cover `all`.
- `subscription_id` (String) The hub's subscription, where its scanner runs, in lowercase. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `subscription_ids` (Set of String) The subscriptions of the tenant the hub scans, in lowercase. Required when `coverage` is `selected` (an empty set scans none); must be unset or empty when `coverage` is `all`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An Azure scanner hub is imported by its tenant's Stream Security id and its subscription.
terraform import streamsec_azure_scanner_hub.security 64f1c0ffee0123456789abcd:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
